deferred_empirical_gates: whether at least two valid empirical HST PSF stars per filter pass the frozen saturation/isolation cuts
whether at least three common Gaia/HST/MUSE sources permit <=0.03 arcsec registration RMS
whether the MUSE star fit passes the frozen 0.47-0.67 arcsec FWHM and beta>1.5 PSF limits
whether pipeline metadata or at least ten sky lines support the frozen MUSE LSF fit
whether blank-stamp HST covariance and MUSE bootstrap spatial/kinematic covariance are positive semidefinite and meet sample-count gates
missing_external_inputs: exact revision, license, file list and SHA-256 manifest for the primary MILES stellar-template library
exact revision, G/K subset rule, license, file list and SHA-256 manifest for the Indo-US cross-check library
exact Gaia DR3 cone-query ADQL, retrieval timestamp, row schema and hash-bound result for the HST/MUSE astrometric field
exact pPXF or equivalent kinematic-extractor version/source hash and frozen invocation
